name: Swedish A2
description: In this module, students gain basic knowledge of Swedish as a foreign language, enabling them with minimal language skills to successfully manage such basic everyday situations. Students will learn/practice basic vocabulary and conversation and produces short texts, such as letters, summaries and short presentations; They deepend and expand their knowledge of grammar learned in level A1 and read simple texts; review pronouns; the complementation of possessive pronouns; the construction of complex main and subordinate clauses using modal verbs; the imperative; preterite; perfect and pluperfect; expressions of time; telling time; adverbs of time, place and direction; comparative adjectives.
prerequisites: A1 (passing grade on final exam at level A1)
